title: Playlist Assistant
not_connected: Not connected — Spotify actions are unavailable until authorization exists.
validation_today_size: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
validation_rare_weight: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
validation_artist_gap: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
validation_history_interval: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440.
help_what_text: It builds a private Spotify playlist from selected sources and listening history.
help_sources_text: Only Spotify playlists marked with #today-source are used as sources.
help_rare_text: Higher values favour tracks with fewer known plays.
help_gap_text: Keeps the configured number of tracks between appearances by the same artist.
help_history_text: Refreshes listening history used for the selection.
help_preview_text: Calculates the next playlist without changing Spotify.
help_publish_text: Writes the current preview to the private target playlist.
help_schedule_text: Home Assistant runs the configured daily workflow at the selected time.
help_last_played_text: Shows relative local time; hover for the exact local timestamp.
